body.name: \(\widehat\psi_{w,n}(O_{ni})\)
body.def: Stack over \((x,k)\) the components \[\widehat\psi^{\ell}_{n,x,k}(O_{ni})=(\mathbf 1\{X_{ni}=x\}-\widehat p_{n,x})\widehat\ell_{n,x,k}+\widehat p_{n,x}\frac{\mathbf 1\{X_{ni}=x\}Z_{ni}}{\max\{N_{n,x,1}/n,1/n\}}\{\mathbf 1\{D_{ni}=1,S_{ni}=1,Y_{ni}=k\}-\widehat q^1_{n,1,x,k}\}-\widehat p_{n,x}\frac{\mathbf 1\{X_{ni}=x\}(1-Z_{ni})}{\max\{N_{n,x,0}/n,1/n\}}\{\mathbf 1\{D_{ni}=1,S_{ni}=1,Y_{ni}=k\}-\widehat q^1_{n,0,x,k}\},\] and \[\widehat\psi^h_{n,x,k}(O_{ni})=(\mathbf 1\{X_{ni}=x\}-\widehat p_{n,x})\widehat h_{n,x,k}+\widehat p_{n,x}\frac{\mathbf 1\{X_{ni}=x\}(1-Z_{ni})}{\max\{N_{n,x,0}/n,1/n\}}\{\mathbf 1\{D_{ni}=0,S_{ni}=1,Y_{ni}=k\}-\widehat q^0_{n,0,x,k}\}-\widehat p_{n,x}\frac{\mathbf 1\{X_{ni}=x\}Z_{ni}}{\max\{N_{n,x,1}/n,1/n\}}\{\mathbf 1\{D_{ni}=0,S_{ni}=1,Y_{ni}=k\}-\widehat q^0_{n,1,x,k}\}.\] If an empirical \((x,z)\) cell is empty, its indicator and residual contribution are exactly zero, so every component is finite on every sample.
